mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.instrument_id, s.trade_date, s.algorithm_version, s.ma5, s.ma10, s.ma20, s.ma60, s.atr14, s.rs20, s.vol_ratio, s.data_status, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.is_synthetic, s.input_hash, s.source_batch FROM indicator_snapshot s JOIN instrument i ON i.id=s.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND s.algorithm_version=(SELECT MAX(n.algorithm_version) FROM indicator_snapshot n WHERE n.instrument_id=s.instrument_id AND n.trade_date=s.trade_date AND n.is_synthetic=s.is_synthetic AND n.algorithm_version IN ('ADJ_V1','ADJ_V2')) AND s.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO indicator_snapshot(instrument_id, trade_date, algorithm_version, ma5, ma10, ma20, ma60, atr14, rs20, vol_ratio, data_status, is_synthetic, input_hash, source_batch) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{algorithmVersion}, #{ma5}, #{ma10}, #{ma20}, #{ma60}, #{atr14}, #{rs20}, #{volRatio}, #{dataStatus}, #{synthetic}, #{inputHash}, #{sourceBatch}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ma5= VALUES(ma5), ma10= VALUES(ma10), ma20= VALUES(ma20), ma60= VALUES(ma60), atr14= VALUES(atr14), rs20= VALUES(rs20), vol_ratio= VALUES(vol_ratio), data_status= VALUES(data_status), is_synthetic= VALUES(is_synthetic), input_hash= VALUES(input_hash), source_batch= VALUES(source_batch)
